articles.title: WhatsApp Patches 3 Security Flaws, Including Android Bug Suspected of Use in Scams
articles.summary:
Meta-owned WhatsApp has addressed security vulnerabilities, including one impacting its Android app that it suspects may have been exploited in connection with scam messages.

The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-23871, has been described as a case of incomplete validation of external ad-reply URLs in WhatsApp for Android and WhatsApp Business for Android before 2.26.17.4.

articles.title: Microsoft Investigates Attachment Upload Failures in New Outlook

articles.summary:

articles.title: AI-Assisted Hackers Deploy 41 PowerShell Scripts to Steal Credentials From African Stock Exchange
articles.summary:

articles.title: Over 100 Debian Packages Still Contain Distrusted CA Certificates Despite Security Updates
